config.inference_unit: base instance, 24 existing development instances; seeds are within-instance repeats
config.primary_comparison: pyvrp_ils_s1e6 versus multistart_vnd, paired mean over seeds then equal-weight over24instances
config.secondary_comparison: pyvrp_ils_s1e9 versus pyvrp_ils_s1e6 for integer-proxy scale sensitivity; same solver family
config.freeze_rule: freeze all source, protocol, manifest and input hashes before first batch solver call
config.stop_rule: all504scheduledcalls once; preserve all failures and timing truncations
config.budgets: same solver CPU ceiling and complete-process wall ceiling for each call; unused budget is not forced to be spent
config.purpose: mature PyVRP integration gate at fixed small development budget, not H1/H2
